en_title: Ghost of Yotei Developer Sucker Punch Hit With Layoffs
subtitle: 「这是艰难的一天」
opus_summary: 据Aftermath报道，Sucker Punch裁员26人。管理层称，市场挑战及下一项目的团队需求调整促成了这一决定，下周将详谈工作室未来计划。

paragraphs.en: Ghost of Yotei developer Sucker Punch has laid off some staff, just a little over a year after the release of its last game.
paragraphs.cn: 《羊蹄山之魂》开发商Sucker Punch裁撤了部分员工，此时距离工作室上一款游戏发售仅过去一年多。

paragraphs.en: Aftermath reported that the studio let 26 employees go, just weeks after Ghost of Yotei's DLC and Complete Edition were released on PS5. The studio has roughly 200 employees as it stands. Aftermath shared an email that was sent out to the team from studio leadership, which reveals that "challenges in the market" and changes in the scope of the team for its next project were the deciding factors in the layoffs.
paragraphs.cn: 据Aftermath报道，工作室裁员26人，而《羊蹄山之魂》DLC及完整版登陆PS5才刚过去几周。工作室目前约有200名员工。Aftermath分享了一封管理层发给团队的邮件，邮件显示，「市场挑战」以及下一项目所需团队规模的变化，是此次裁员的决定性因素。

paragraphs.en: “After carefully observing the challenges in the market and reviewing the team needs for our next project, we've decided to make some staffing reductions. Several positions across Sucker Punch will be eliminated as a result," the email reads.
paragraphs.cn: 邮件写道：「在仔细观察市场面临的挑战，并审视下一项目的团队需求后，我们决定缩减人员。因此，Sucker Punch将裁撤多个岗位。」

paragraphs.en: The note also stated that they will discuss the plans for the studio's future next week.
paragraphs.cn: 邮件还表示，管理层将于下周讨论工作室的未来计划。

paragraphs.en: ”We know this is a lot to take in, and we want to assure you that we did not make this decision lightly. We have given this a lot of attention and worked to support our affected colleagues during this transition as well as we can. … There's no getting around that this is a hard day. Next week we will go into more details about the future.”
paragraphs.cn: 「我们知道，这些消息一时很难消化，也想向大家保证，我们并非轻率地作出这个决定。我们对此慎重考虑，并尽力在这一过渡期为受到影响的同事提供支持。……无法回避的是，这是艰难的一天。下周，我们会更详细地谈谈未来。」

paragraphs.en: As of right now, it's unclear what Sucker Punch's next game will be; it does sound like there is another project in the cards based on the studio's statement. Some want a return to Infamous, whether through a collection of remasters/remakes or a brand-new entry. Others want a new Sly Cooper. And of course, there's appetite for more games in the studio's Ghost series. It wouldn't be surprising if at least one of these happens, as new IP with a big AAA budget is becoming harder and harder to justify.
paragraphs.cn: 目前，Sucker Punch的下一款游戏尚不明确，但从工作室的声明来看，似乎确实有另一个项目在计划之中。有些玩家希望《声名狼藉》系列回归，无论是推出复刻或重制合集，还是全新作品。另一些玩家则希望看到《狡狐大冒险》新作。当然，也有玩家期待工作室的《魂》系列推出更多游戏。这些期待中至少有一个成真也不足为奇，毕竟，为全新IP投入高额3A预算正变得越来越难以证明合理。

paragraphs.en: Ghost of Yotei was one of the biggest games of fall 2025, selling 3.3 million copies in its first month . It's also one of the best-reviewed PS5 exclusives to date. It was also expected to come to PC at some point, but unfortunately, that plan was scrapped when Sony opted to move away from PC . The game recently got a Complete Edition , which added a brand-new story DLC and other additional content. It's unclear if this moved any significant copies or if the audience for the game already capped out with its initial release.
paragraphs.cn: 《羊蹄山之魂》是2025年秋季最受瞩目的游戏之一，首月售出330万份，也是迄今评价最高的PS5独占游戏之一。该作原本也预计会在某个时候登陆PC，但遗憾的是，索尼决定不再侧重PC平台后，这一计划便被取消。游戏近期推出了完整版，加入全新剧情DLC及其他额外内容。目前尚不清楚，完整版是否带来了可观的销量，还是这款游戏的受众在最初发售时就已触及上限。

paragraphs.en: The layoffs also come during a tumultuous time for PlayStation, which has been upsetting fans over its controversial shift to an all-digital future starting in 2028 . The company will phase out physical copies of games in favor of digital releases, likely beginning with PS6. PlayStation also shuttered Bluepoint , a beloved studio that was best known for high-quality remasters, ports, and remakes such as Demon's Souls for PS5. Additionally, PlayStation attempted to scrap development on Hideo Kojima's next gen game, Physint, until Microsoft swooped in to save it .
paragraphs.cn: 此次裁员也正值PlayStation动荡之际。PlayStation将从2028年起转向全数字化，这一颇具争议的转变引发了粉丝不满。公司将逐步淘汰实体游戏，转而发行数字版，很可能从PS6开始。PlayStation还关闭了备受玩家喜爱的Bluepoint。这家工作室以高质量的复刻、移植和重制作品闻名，代表作包括PS5版《恶魔之魂》。此外，PlayStation曾试图取消小岛秀夫次世代游戏《Physint》的开发，直到微软出手才保住了这个项目。
